terms.definition: An exact location with no size at all.
terms.function: Marks one spot on a plane.
terms.whereItIs: The lettered dot on the board.
terms.whyItMatters: Points are the foundation of every geometric shape.

terms.definition: The visible mark used to represent a point.
terms.function: Shows where the point is located.
terms.whereItIs: The tiny sphere on the board.
terms.whyItMatters: A real point is too small to see — the dot is its symbol.

terms.definition: A flat surface extending forever, holding all points.
terms.function: Provides the space where positions are measured.
terms.whereItIs: The flat board under the dot.
terms.whyItMatters: Positions only make sense on a surface.

terms.definition: The point where two rays meet to form an angle.
terms.function: The corner point shared by an angle's rays.
terms.whereItIs: Where the rays meet in later lessons.
terms.whyItMatters: Vertices are the points that name shapes.
